children: ), one of the world's largest independent technology and professional services firms, today announced the acquisition of Callibrity, strengthening CGI's presence in Cincinnati and expanding the company's capabilities in production-ready enterprise AI, platform engineering and digital product development. The transaction closed on September 8, 2026.

Founded in 2007, Callibrity is an end-to-end technology consulting firm that brings together developers, strategists and engineers to help clients solve complex technology challenges. The firm works across commercial industries, with deep experience in financial services, insurance and manufacturing.

"Cincinnati represents an exciting market for CGI and an opportunity to further establish our presence with a highly respected team that shares our commitment to delivering meaningful outcomes for clients," said Vijay Srinivasan, President of U.S. Commercial and State Government operations at CGI. "Callibrity brings deep technical expertise, a strong consulting mindset and a culture of curiosity and collaboration that align well with CGI. Together, we can build on the trusted relationships and expertise Callibrity has established while bringing clients CGI's broader capabilities, industry insight and global scale."

Callibrity brings 120 consultants to CGI and strengthens its presence in the Cincinnati metro market. For Callibrity's clients, joining CGI provides continued access to the teams, expertise and collaborative approach they rely on today, with access to an expanded range of services and CGI's global delivery network.

"We founded Callibrity on a simple idea: bring smart, talented technologists together, ask the right questions and build solutions that make a meaningful difference for our clients," said Gary Howard, CEO of Callibrity. "Joining CGI gives us the opportunity to build on what has made Callibrity successful while expanding what we can offer our clients and our people. We see this as the next chapter in what we've built together, with greater capabilities and opportunities while staying true to the curiosity, expertise and relationships at the heart of Callibrity."

Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent technology and professional services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2025 reported revenue is CA$15.91 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at
